welcome: Welcome to our place. We're glad you're here. Make yourself at home, help yourself to the kitchen, and ask us if you need anything.

rules.title: Shoes off inside
rules.body: Please take your shoes off at the door. We really appreciate it.

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.body: Please keep noise low late at night and early in the morning, so everyone can sleep.

rules.title: Your room's air conditioning
rules.body: Your room has its own air conditioning zone. Please turn it off when you head out for the day.

rules.title: Lock up when you leave
rules.body: Please close the windows and lock the door when the house is empty.

howto.title: Wi-Fi and air conditioning
howto.body: Both are on this TV. Scan the code in the corner to open the same details on your phone.

howto.title: Kitchen
howto.body: Help yourself to tea, coffee and the basics. Please wash up your dishes or load the dishwasher.

howto.title: Laundry
howto.body: Ask us before you use the washing machine so we can show you how it works.

items.name: Raes Dining Room
items.note: A special dinner in a bright, breezy room at Wategos Beach.

items.name: Pixie Food & Wine
items.note: Relaxed coastal Italian with a very good wine list.

items.name: Beach Byron Bay
items.note: Casual coastal dining with ocean views over Clarkes Beach.

items.name: The Balcony Bar & Oyster Co.
items.note: Oysters and drinks above Jonson Street. Good for a casual lunch.

items.name: Cape Byron Lighthouse
items.note: Built in 1901. Walk up for big views of the coast.

items.name: Cape Byron Walking Track
items.note: A loop of about 3.7 km, around 2 hours. You can walk just a short section.

items.name: Whale watching from the headland
items.note: Humpbacks head south from September to November. Bring binoculars.

items.name: Little Wategos
items.note: A quiet little beach and lookout, just off the main track.

items.name: Bayleaf Cafe
items.note: A local favourite for breakfast and a good flat white.

items.name: Folk
items.note: Easy, friendly cafe for coffee and a bite.

items.name: Barefoot Brew Room
items.note: Early starts for a quick coffee before the beach.

items.name: Wategos Beach
items.note: A lovely beach for a swim. Toilets are close by.

items.name: The Pass
items.note: A popular spot for surfing and a swim.

items.name: Clarkes Beach
items.note: A long beach near town. Easy to walk to the cafes.

items.name: Captain Cook Lookout
items.note: A great view along the track. Good at sunrise.

items.name: The Pass to Wategos
items.note: A short coastal walk between two beaches.

steps: Strip the bed and leave the sheets in a pile
Put used towels in the laundry
Wash up or load the dishwasher
Take all your things from your room and the bathroom
Turn off the air conditioning in your room
Close the windows and lock the door behind you
